description.fun: Beldum has no blood: every cell in its body is a magnet, and it uses magnetism to move, talk to other Beldum and aim its attacks. Swarms move in perfect sync, and an angry Beldum can break nearby machines with its magnetic field. It sleeps hooked onto a cliff by the claws on its rear. Its name and shape come from a dumbbell.
description.guide: A Steel- and Psychic-type Pokémon that looks like a one-eyed robot and is made of magnetic cells. It is rare in the wild and lives in rugged terrain. It evolves into Metang at level 20.
description.tagline: A magnetic dumbbell that sleeps hanging from a cliff

description.fun: Metang forms when two Beldum fuse, their brains linked by a magnetic nervous system that doubles their psychic power, though not their intelligence. It hovers on magnetism and can swing its arms back to fly at over 100 km/h. Its body is so strong a jet can't scratch it, and its claws can rip through steel. It loves chasing Nosepass for their magnetic minerals.
description.guide: A Steel- and Psychic-type Pokémon formed from two Beldum fused together, which hovers using magnetism and lives in rough, mountainous terrain. It evolves from Beldum at level 20 and into Metagross at level 45.
description.tagline: Two Beldum fused into one flying, steel-clawed saucer

description.fun: Metagross is two Metang fused together, so it has four brains linked by a complex web of nerves, making it smarter than a supercomputer. It analyses its opponents mid-battle and pins its prey under its huge weight, and its magnetic powers grow stronger in freezing cold. Its name may play on a 'gross', twelve dozen, since it weighs 1,212 pounds.
description.guide: A Steel- and Psychic-type Pokémon formed from two Metang fused together, with four brains and a cross-shaped face. It evolves from Metang at level 45 and is the final form of Beldum. It can Mega Evolve with the Metagrossite.
description.tagline: A four-brained steel giant smarter than a supercomputer

description.fun: Mega Metagross links a Metagross, a Metang and two Beldum into one, and its extra brainpower makes it a ruthless fighter that will win by any means; if victory looks impossible, it digs in its claws and prepares to explode. It floats constantly, with its legs turned into arms, and it's the heaviest Mega Evolution of all.
